items.title: Carney Says Anthropic Ban Shows Risk of Relying on Big AI Models

items.title: AI and the Red Queen
items.raw_excerpt: “My dear, here we must run as fast as we can, just to stay in place. And if you wish to go anywhere you must run twice as fast as that.” ― Lewis Carroll, Alice in Wonderland I find myself returning to quote, time and time again. AI is moving so fast. How can you possibly hope to keep up? The Builder’s Dilemma Link to heading “If you build it, you must maintain it” - I think this is my quote (Inspired by Wayne’s World “If you book them, they will come”).

title_i18n.en: AI and the Red Queen
title_i18n.zh: 人工智能与红皇后
title_i18n.es: La IA y la Reina Roja

excerpt_i18n.en: “My dear, here we must run as fast as we can, just to stay in place. And if you wish to go anywhere you must run twice as fast as that.” ― Lewis Carroll, Alice in Wonderland I find myself returning to quote, time and time again. AI is moving so fast. excerpt_i18n.zh: 亲爱的，我们得拼命奔跑，才能留在原地。要是想去别的地方，就得跑得比这快一倍才行。——刘易斯·卡罗尔《爱丽丝梦游仙境》我发现自己一次又一次地想起这句话
excerpt_i18n.es: Querida, aquí debemos correr tan rápido como podamos solo para mantenernos en el mismo sitio. Y si quieres llegar a alguna parte, debes correr el doble de rápido. — Lewis Carroll, Alicia en el País de las Maravillas. Me encuentro volviendo a esta cita, una y otra vez.

items.title: Hillock – Local, brain-inspired AI memory using SQLite and HDC
items.raw_excerpt: Hillock is an open-source project that combines SQLite and Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) for local, brain-inspired AI memory storage without cloud dependency. It encodes information into high-dimensional vectors for efficient local storage and retrieval, suitable for privacy-sensitive or offline applications.

title_i18n.en: Hillock – Local, brain-inspired AI memory using SQLite and HDC

title_i18n.es: Hillock – Memoria local de IA inspirada en el cerebro, que utiliza SQLite y HDC.

excerpt_i18n.en: Hillock is an open-source project that combines SQLite and Hyperdimensional Computing (HDC) for local, brain-inspired AI memory storage without cloud dependency. It encodes information into high-dimensional vectors for efficient local storage and retrieval, suitable for privacy-sensitive or offline applications.
excerpt_i18n.zh: Hillock 是一个开源项目，结合 SQLite 和超维计算（HDC）实现本地、类脑的 AI 记忆存储，无需依赖云服务。它通过将信息编码为高维向量，在本地高效存储和检索记忆，适用于隐私敏感或离线场景。
